name: @beatpass/documentation
description: Quality gates for the BeatPass Mintlify documentation.

scripts.docs:mint: mint validate --client-version 0.0.3517 && mint broken-links --check-anchors --check-redirects --check-snippets && mint a11y
scripts.docs:quality: npm run docs:audit && npm run docs:publication && npm run docs:developer-publication && npm run docs:review && npm run docs:release && npm run docs:coverage && npm run docs:media && npm run docs:test && npm run docs:openapi && npm run docs:mint && npm run docs:vale
